guidance.text: The mismatch between composite transport T₀₂ = 5 and the composed transport T₁₂ ∘ T₀₁ = 6 is a curvature invariant K = -1; flat relation holds iff K = 0.

How to compute oriented differences δ_ij = σ_j - T_ij σ_i and identify when the 2-cell path relation induces a curvature obstruction to the identity-transport control.
No single 1-cochain α satisfies δ + d₀α = 0 across all three edges when K ≠ 0; the obstruction is inherent to the data and requires either transport adjustment or acceptance of non-flat curvature.

The identity-transport zero-obstruction control δ + d₀α = 0 cannot be satisfied for all three edges simultaneously with a single 1-cochain α; the obstruction is detected by the failure of the boundary condition on the 2-cell path relation.
Antiskill: Do not assume that δ_ij = σ_j - σ_i is compatible with transport composition; always verify the 2-cell path relation before claiming zero obstruction.
